messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Steven, your order Shop···· is paid and still to ship: two Magic Miner 40T units plus the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA.

Where it stands: all units are built and shipped together, and Magic Miner expects them to ship out from the factory on November 12. Your tracking is emailed the moment your miner ships to you.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sorry we have not kept you better updated on this one. Anything else I can check?
Before you go, one thing: what made you order two Magic Miner 40Ts rather than one unit to start?

Heating various spaces, small seacan, bedrooms etc, I’m on solar. So power is essentially free and these units will pay me to do it. I have Avalon q and mini 3’s. From what I’ve seen the Magic miner will match or exceed both of those units.
That's a sharp setup. What decides it for you when a unit goes in a bedroom, the noise or the heat output?
Size of the room vs heat output. Magic miner on 30th using 430w isn’t going to heat a large area. Whereas a Avalon Q at 1375w will heat a normal-large size room
Makes sense. For the seacan, which is the bigger space, what are you planning to put in there?
9ft seacan, magic miner if it can keep up over the winter.
Noted, thanks Steven, that's genuinely useful to hear. Alberta winter in a seacan will be a real test. Enjoy the units when they land.
